card.name: Nameless Fate
card.description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

card.name: Sun Smith
card.description: Help an ancient derelict repair itself. Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

card.name: Street Football: Foul Play
card.description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

card.name: Inside the Samosbor
card.description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

card.name: Corner Quest
card.description: An idle auto-battler in the corner of your screen. Your Mage fights on her own while you work. Choose her Spells, reshape them with Forms and Runes, and fight through 50+ waves in 15 Biomes.

card.name: One More Potato
card.description: One More Potato is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,000 potatoes into their correct places across a countryside farm. Pick up potatoes, complete collections, unlock helpful upgrades, and turn a messy farm into a perfectly organized potato paradise, solo or with friends.

card.name: Carrot Planet
card.description: An entire planet of carrots to harvest. Team up with up to 16 players online, pick carrots, drive vehicles, automate everything, and befriend the locals. Build a massive carrot empire together in this cozy incremental automation life sim!

card.name: Luck and Raid
card.description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

card.name: Sorted by Christmas
card.description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

card.name: Overcharge
card.description: Overcharge is a chaotic robot-themed co-op action platformer where holding the Energy Core for too long gets your team wiped. Grab 1-3 friends and pass it around as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps.

card.name: Starfuse
card.description: A cozy fireworks incremental where your upgrade tree is the night sky. Set your Shell Rack, pop drifting wish lanterns and chain bursts that relight the stars. Every place adds its own rule and a new toy, from lighthouse beams to storm clouds, until you can rekindle the dead Sun.

card.name: Saw Down
card.description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

card.name: Put Out The Sun
card.description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Spit, spray and haul water as a crew of four-armed aliens, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the Sun finally goes dark. Play solo or with up to 6 friends.

card.name: Apartment Empire
card.description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.

card.name: Fire Up the Stadium
card.description: Fire Up the Stadium is an incremental restoration game where you bring a massive stadium back to its former glory. Restore faded seats, earn money, unlock powerful tools and upgrades, and build automated restoration machines. The more seats you restore, the faster and more powerful you become!

card.name: Just! Yell! FireBall!
card.description: Turn your voice into magic in this chaotic online PvP party game! Shout spells into your microphone, collect magic scrolls, dodge incoming attacks, and blast your rivals away in colorful arenas. Challenge friends, other players, or bots!

card.name: Bakebound
card.description: Bakebound is a short, active incremental game about harvesting a magical field that fights back. Sweep through living crops, dodge their attacks, and bake what you gather into recipes that make every trip stronger.

card.name: Treasured Carpets
card.description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

card.name: SHOVEL BRIGADE
card.description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

card.name: One Last Fish
card.description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

card.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
card.description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

card.name: Chaos Conquest
card.description: Chaos Conquest is a casual incremental auto-battler set in a fantasy world. Mine gold, grow your army from a lone soldier into a mighty battalion, and watch as your soldiers defeat hordes of quirky enemies!

card.name: Sort, Spell & Meow
card.description: Have you ever seen a cozy organizing game where the items actually fly? You broke into the witch’s workshop looking for valuable artifacts, but the cat activated one of them. Now everything is floating — everything swirls around the room. Put everything back in place to find what you came for.

card.name: Rally King
card.description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

card.name: All Haul the King
card.description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

card.name: Enchantalot
card.description: Strike and enchant weapons on a magic workbench. Each success makes them stronger and worth more - but the higher you climb, the riskier every blow. Send your gear out on quests, collect relics that build on each other, and watch the numbers spiral out of control.

card.name: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
card.description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

card.name: Sol Mates
card.description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

card.name: CTRL+ALT+BURN
card.description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

card.name: Pixel Life
card.description: Move to the cozy pixel town of Pinewood and build a life from scratch. Land a job and climb the career ladder, cook, fish, paint, make friends and fall in love, all while keeping your needs up and making rent every Monday. Chase your dream, one day at a time.

card.name: Secret of Nox
card.description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

card.name: The Last Coin
card.description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

card.name: Bad Call
card.description: Bad Call is a social game for 3-6 players set in an underground bunker. You're locked in separate rooms. Win challenges, trade code digits, forge alliances, and lie over the phone. Everyone needs the same exit code, but not everyone will escape.

card.name: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
card.description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

card.name: Poutamelo
card.description: Create your own music and share your finished sheet music with the townspeople. Then, visit the local live music bar to hear them perform your songs. Help out with farming, get to know your neighbors, and create your own story in a peaceful little town in this life simulation game.

card.name: Chain Detonator
card.description: Set mines, lure robots into your trap and trigger explosive chain reactions—then escape the blast. A top-down action-puzzle game with 50 campaign levels, solo challenges, local PvP for 2–4 players and online PvP for up to 16 on dedicated servers.

card.name: Mall Security
card.description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

card.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
card.description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

card.name: MOONWRIGHT
card.description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. Age of a new Gold Rush started and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores and sell what you mined. Use money to upgrade rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

card.name: Mop & Plot
card.description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

card.name: The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
card.description: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fish and out-fence your old captain to a legendary hoard.

card.name: Leaf to Sun
card.description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

card.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
card.description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

card.name: Kibble Rescue
card.description: A cozy first-person cleanup game. The shop cats tore open a giant bag of pet food and buried Happy Paws Pet Shop under a million kibbles. Scoop it up, pack it into crates, wrap and ship the boxes, buy bigger tools, and put every product back on its shelf before closing time.

card.name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
card.description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

card.name: Living With Dad - Family Party
card.description: Take on the Championn’Appart challenge with Dad’s Girls in this colourful party game! Who will take the top spot on the podium?

card.name: Sitry & Chami Desktop Pet
card.description: Meet Sitry & Chami, your adorable hand-painted gouache desktop companions! Watch them climb active windows, dangle their legs from title bars, play bongo drums to your keyboard typing, and hilariously prank your screen with paint splatters and squeaky hammers.

card.name: Clara Wraiths 3
card.description: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

card.name: Charmosaic
card.description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

card.name: Holy Nest
card.description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

card.name: Dummy Works
card.description: Unleash chaos on test dummies in this physics sandbox, but not all is as it seems.

card.name: Impferno
card.description: An online co-op game for up to 8 players. Explore the Circles of Hell in search of monsters and collect their souls before time runs out. Work and fight together to survive. But never forget: trust has no place among demons!

card.name: Pack it! Part-Time Master
card.description: Scan! Stack! The ultimate basket-packing challenge! Become a part-time master!

card.name: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
card.description: One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city... Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

card.name: One Million Chips
card.description: A short first-person incremental game set in a flooded casino. Scoop, rake, shovel and vacuum one million in chips into the giant funnel, spend your tips at Valeria's counter, and clear every last chip from the Casino Fortuna.

card.name: Deadlines
card.description: A multiplayer melee combat game where you and your coworkers are trapped in a sprawling office building with an impossible deadline. Work together to survive, form alliances to improve your odds, or turn on your coworkers before they turn on you.

card.name: Planet Chess
card.description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

card.name: Knock Twice
card.description: Queens, 1974. Something in Garland Court knocks twice, and it can only come in if you answer. It wears your neighbours' voices. Check the peephole, count the shadows, keep the chain on. Five apartments, three years of the building's past, thirty-two endings.

card.name: This is not just a farm
card.description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

card.name: HIGH HORNS
card.description: CLIMB TO CONQUER! Physics-based co-op VR climbing
